title: Join bucket WAL, replica, authorization, backend, and interface conformance

authority.statement: BucketService@1 is the runtime authority for virtual-bucket lifecycle, object, quota, placement, and recovery semantics. BucketCatalog@1 owns generation-scoped publication and durable compensation journals. Only non-primary replicas that are durable and integrity-verified count toward minimum_verified_replicas. Python, CLI, and MCP surfaces project registry-bound operations and must not reimplement catalog or placement logic. Unavailable or unsupported backend capabilities reject explicitly with zero effects and no silent fallback.

declared_backends.role: canonical hermetic primary for differential and crash corpus
second placement for multi-store saga and verified-replica evidence
capability-gated unsupported provider; rejects storage without fallback
declared_backends.unavailable_disposition: explicit unsupported rejection; no silent fallback

evidence_subset.lifecycle: Provisioning to active publication is multi-backend transactional; illegal transitions and equal names on different backends stay distinct.
evidence_subset.object: Put/get/list/delete and CAS version preconditions match across independent service instances for deterministic schedules.
evidence_subset.transfer: Export binds catalog generation plus content digests; corrupt import fails before catalog publication.
evidence_subset.query: QueryMode and query_indexing cross-field policy invariants reject contradictory configurations before any effect.
evidence_subset.quota: Concurrent and sequential quota admissions enforce policy.quota_bytes and policy.quota_objects with a single admitted winner.
evidence_subset.placement: Partial multi-store placement either compensates immediately or leaves a durable recoverable compensation receipt.
evidence_subset.crash: WAL crash injection at every named execute boundary recovers to pre-commit compensation or committed replay; second recovery is a no-op. Bucket delete/create recovery rehydrates from the catalog journal after service reconstruction.
evidence_subset.auth: Protected bucket mutations deny unauthorized principals with zero handler dispatch and zero backend effects on every interface surface.
evidence_subset.parity: Python, CLI, and MCP projections of registry-bound bucket operations match after transport-only fields are stripped.
evidence_subset.backend: Unsupported provider storage capabilities and insufficient BackendCapability records reject without effects or success/no-op fallback.

differential_corpus.generator: deterministic Python random.Random(seed) schedules over advertised bucket operations
